arabic_html:
مَّثَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ أَمْوَٰلَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنۢبَتَتْ سَبْعَ سَنَابِلَ فِى كُلِّ سُنۢبُلَةٍۢ مِّا۟ئَةُ حَبَّةٍۢ ۗ
وَٱللَّهُ يُضَٰعِفُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ۗ
وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ ۞
translation: The example of those who spend their wealth in the way of Allah is like a seed of grain which grows seven spikes; in each spike is a hundred grains. And Allah multiplies His reward for whom He wills. And Allah is all - Encompassing and Knowing.
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: a parable far heavier on the heart than a number. Allah grows what you spend the way He grows a crop in good soil — multiplied ten to seven hundred times.
